newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ito En slides in morning after stock sale.
newsitem.headline: Ito En slides in morning after stock sale.

text.p: Shares of Ito En Ltd slid in Tuesday morning trade after the firm sold four million of its shares to investors when it was listed on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Monday, traders said.
Shares of Ito En had been traded on the over-the-counter (OTC) market before the listing.
The share price closed the morning session down 90 yen at 2,310 yen. The volume was 23,000 shares.
The beverage manufacturer sold the four million shares at 2,412 yen on Monday, prompting investors who held latent losses in the shares to sell them to cut losses, they said.
